sbd_weighted_iridium_position.POSITION_ERROR_COMMENT: A subset of the available Iridium Positions were used that are deemed 'independent': 6; Error was computed as the square root of the inverse sum of the weights, where each weight is the inverse square of the individual measurement error: Weights=1/(error^2)
